WITH w AS (
 SELECT o.web_order_id, o.status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS disp,
        CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS ord
 FROM fact_web_order o),
l AS (
 SELECT f.receipt_id, f.sale_date, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(*) n
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT 'by_dispatch' k, count(*) orders, sum(l.net) net, sum(l.n) lines FROM l JOIN w ON w.web_order_id=l.receipt_id WHERE w.disp BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'by_saledate', count(*), sum(l.net), sum(l.n) FROM l WHERE l.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
UNION ALL

UNION ALL
SELECT 'lines_without_order', count(*),0,0 FROM l LEFT JOIN w ON w.web_order_id=l.receipt_id WHERE w.web_order_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'status_'||status, count(*), 0,0 FROM w WHERE ord BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY status

WITH x AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, f.sale_date, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1,2),
c AS (SELECT store_id, business_date, net_sales_before_returns nb, receipts FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND store_id<900)
SELECT count(*) pairs, sum(abs(coalesce(x.net,0)-coalesce(c.nb,0))>0.01 ::int) diffs, sum(coalesce(x.net,0)) wh, sum(coalesce(c.nb,0)) ctl, sum(coalesce(x.rc,0)) wh_rc, sum(coalesce(c.receipts,0)) ctl_rc
FROM x FULL JOIN c ON c.store_id=x.store_id AND c.business_date=x.sale_date

WITH r AS (
 SELECT f.receipt_id, s.store_id=900 w, sum(f.net_amount) net, count(*) n
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id<>999 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02' GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT w, count(*), avg(net), min(net), quantile_cont(net,0.5) med, quantile_cont(net,0.99) p99, max(net), max(n) FROM r GROUP BY w

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, s.store_id, COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND s.store_id = 900
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND (s.store_id < 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(l.net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT l.receipt_id), 2) AS atv,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.store_id < 900 THEN l.receipt_id END) AS store_receipts,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN l.store_id < 900 THEN l.net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.store_id < 900 THEN l.receipt_id END), 2) AS stores_only_atv,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN l.store_id = 900 THEN l.net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.store_id = 900 THEN l.receipt_id END), 2) AS web_atv
FROM lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 1 AND 3
GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
      AND dispatch_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-05-01' AND dispatch_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-10'
),
lines AS (
    SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, s.store_id, w.dispatch_date AS business_date
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
    UNION ALL
    SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, s.store_id, f.sale_date
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag
      AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(net_amount) AS net_sales_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT receipt_id), 2) AS atv,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id < 900 THEN receipt_id END) AS store_receipts,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN store_id < 900 THEN net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id < 900 THEN receipt_id END), 2) AS stores_only_atv,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id = 900 THEN receipt_id END) AS web_receipts,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN store_id = 900 THEN net_amount END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN store_id = 900 THEN receipt_id END), 2) AS web_atv
FROM lines
WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-08-02'
